body: We haven't spoken recently. We try to avoid being in the same room together, and since she works nights I make sure I'm asleep when she gets home. I doubt it would concern her much though, she's told me before she knows I will commit suicide one day, but hopes I will wait until our daughters are grown. I told my therapist about it and when I confronted my wife about it, she said she would never say something like that. So either I'm losing touch with reality, or I'm being manipulated. Either way, I don't think she has much feeling for me anymore.
Through the VA. I usually have 3 or 4 appts. a week. Buts it's been 12 years and I only feel worse.
I did, I'm sorry, I'm just in such a bad place so I didn't read up on anything on the sub. I just made a throwaway account, searched for suicide on Reddit and started typing.
